workflow_scale_routing.rationale: One sound artifact can hold the movement through internal arrangement sections without becoming a sound sequence.
reroute_triggers: Artist requests dependent parts, a sequence or series, durable canon, or long-form drafting across sessions.

sonic_concept_direction.primary_sonic_concept: an intimate nocturnal song where room tone, breath, and a fragile piano motif carry the unresolved threshold
sonic_concept_direction.target_sonic_engine: sparse piano, close vocal, low sub pressure, soft rain-like texture, and unresolved harmonic color
sonic_concept_direction.rationale: A close song form can preserve the human threshold while sparse sound makes absence active.

genre_direction.rationale: Alt-R&B supports close vocal tenderness while downtempo ambient production preserves threat and absence.

tempo_groove_direction.rationale: A slow tempo preserves stillness while the pulse keeps the decision physically present.

vocal_lyric_policy.vocal_direction: close, restrained lead vocal with almost-whispered verses and a clearer but unresolved chorus
vocal_lyric_policy.rights_notes: New lyrics should be drafted from the approved brief, not copied from the source text.
vocal_lyric_policy.rationale: New lyrics can preserve the source's emotional structure while becoming singable.

section_strategy.tension_role: establish the room without resolving it
state the unresolved emotional thesis without resolving it

arrangement_direction.dynamic_arc: quiet invitation, tightening pressure, restrained release, unresolved final return
arrangement_direction.ending_behavior: end on an unresolved piano fragment and room tone

active_sonic_tensions.name: Sparse / Dense
translation_notes: Keep the mix sparse while allowing pressure to accumulate.

active_sonic_tensions.name: Resolved / Unresolved
translation_notes: Avoid clean cadences; let the ending remain suspended.

genre_sonic_conflicts.conflict: Alt-R&B warmth could over-resolve the grief.
genre_sonic_conflicts.adaptation: Keep the vocal warm but hold harmony unresolved and leave negative space around the pulse.

sequence_plan.sequence_summary: One compact song translates the single threshold beat.

traceability_summary.note: The sound plan translates the shared threshold beat into section movement and unresolved harmonic pressure.
